annotations.title: Is this image AI-generated? AI image detector

description: AI image detector: check an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or single-page TIFF, up to 20 MiB) by public URL or base64. Reads the evidence in the file first (C2PA Content Credentials naming the generator or camera, IPTC AI labels, prompts saved by Stable Diffusion tools, EXIF), then adds an AI-likelihood score from the image detector. Use for: is this photo real or AI, is this a deepfake, was this made with Midjourney, DALL-E, Firefly or ChatGPT? A score is an estimate; records are evidence. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

image_base64.description: File bytes as base64 or a data: URL, up to 20 MiB decoded. Prefer url when the file is public.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private network and local addresses are refused.
